notes.title: A minor update with a BIG CHANGE!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

With the ongoing contest on [url=https://playquest.fun]playquest[/url], we wanted to address a small issue that will be a big quality of life improvement there: saving!

While the code was half there already, we didn't have any plans on releasing a demo that could save its progress. It's rather short after all. But since we can now replay missions and try to better scores, it's quite nice to be able to start the game without having to replay it from the start.

So here it is, an update that has no new content but progress being saved.

Oh, and we also fixed the sound of the engine of the ambulance that was missing. Sorry, my bad...

As always, do not hesitate to tell us if you have a problem or what you think of the game. We are all ears! Come to our discord for the quickest replies!

Good luck & have fun :)

notes.title: Devlog #20 - Big Demo Update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been talking about it for two months, it's finally here! This is a big update with numerous changes that, we hope, greatly improve the game. With these changes it's more comfort and more fun that are coming to [b]Highway to Heal[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/7a9c30a152e62fdd045f13f5aaa0cee2119cc331.gif[/img]

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
🏎 [b]More fun driving [/b]: a slight straight line assistance and drifting! Be careful when it's raining 😜
🗺 [b]Holowatch disppeared[/b]! Missions are now started automatically and the map is semi-automated
💉 You can now [b]start treatments[/b] by yourself while driving!
💬 [b]Dialogs[/b] while driving have been completely revamped
🚑 First missions have been [b]simplified[/b]
🥇 New end of [b]mission[/b] screen
🎁 More explicit display of [b]rewards[/b]
🚸 The [b]tutorial [/b]is now directly integrated into the adventure
🌳 Many [b]shortcuts [/b]to discover
🚑 [b]Collisions [/b] have been improved: it's now easier to slip through!
💥 Re-balanced [b]damages[/b]
🚧 [b]Roadworks[/b] are now automatically added to the minimap
🐈 New equipment to discover: [b]The Cat Siren[/b]!
⚙ [b]New interface[/b] for the integrity and equipment of the ambulance
💡 [b]Flash[/b] on the ambulance and patient when they are hit
🛠 Time is added when the ambulance gets [b]towed[/b]
📻 New display of the radio[b]radio [/b]with the top left corner and control with a dedicated key
🎥 [b]Alternate view [/b]following the vehicle
🚨 The [b]siren[/b] can't get damaged anymore and is available outside of missions
🚮 [b]Trashcans and street lamps[/b] don't cause damage anymore
📦 [b]Trucks[/b] transports cargo
💻 Vehicles now know how to stop before turning at crossroads
🐞 Many many [b]bugfixes[/b], varied [b]improvements [/b] and [b]optimizations[/b]

It's crazy how two months of work can be condensed in such a short list. 

C'est fou comme deux mois de travail peuvent être condensés dans une liste si courte. It must be said that we don't necessarily realize how much work goes into the last line! 😆

We have updated the feedback questionnaire. Do not hesitate to fill it again to tell us what you think of all the changes. We are especially interested in what you think about the two camera views.

If you would like to support us, you can still pre-order the game in [url=ulule.com/highwaytoheal]our crowdfunding campaign[/url]. 

Thanks for reading this news. We hope you will enjoy all the changes. Good luck & [b]have fun[/b]!

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #17 - Big changes coming!
notes.notes:
I'm not sure if we can call this weekly since the last one was almost a month ago, haha! But we're going to try to keep this weekly (or biweekly) again. Anyway, Hello everyone!

[h2]A Successful Crowdfunding[/h2]
We're very glad to be out of this one. Crowdfunding campaigns are super stressful. Ours concluded with a success but a mere hours before the end! It was to be expected, especially with a small platform like Ulule. Even with our half way start due to our Game Cup prize, it was tough.

[img]https://media.ulule.com/presales/3/8/7/0/0/2/200783/untitled.ghDI2DQGJg.png[/img]
But it's very nice that we got not just our 5000€ prize but double that! A massive thank you to all our supporters, we won't thank you enough. This money will surely help us get through the year!

Also... [b]It's still active![/b] We left it open until the end of the year so people can still pledge. If you want to name a street of the game, there's still time! :)

[url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/57ce38b99131383ba24ce4ab8b051dcaa0a36c8a.png[/img][/url]

Since the campaign ended, Daniel took a much needed week off while Thomas went on to pitch the game at the Game Camp in Lille. For us, the goal in going to this event was double. Find partners to help us finish financing the game and see if we could help other developers in their developments.

[h2]Design changes[/h2]
While showing the game to professional game developers or editors and mixing it with the feedback we got on our demo from players and streamers, we got nice ideas that we are currently implementing. Some of it already is programmed but none of it already got an updated interface so it's going to be hard to show you the changes, ahah! You'll play them with the next demo update anyway so just be patient ;)

[h3]Caring[/h3]
Like many of the changes we are doing, this one is very small with big consequences. No more surprises, you are now going to be able to trigger the caring mini-games yourselves and actively treat your patient on the road! If you stop, pressing the A button will trigger the full screen game. If you dare press the A button while driving, you'll play the mini version above the ambulance. In both cases, there will be a cooldown period between each use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/0be680e6f7e7e4bd5fbb99b3031599024812f47f.gif[/img]

[h3]Equipments[/h3]
The way equipments break was not very clear so we are going to make it simpler. Instead of each equipment having its own health status, there is going to be a general ambulance integrity bar above them with various sections. The more equipment you have, the more sections it has. When the integrity falls into a new section, one of your equipment breaks. It's not purely random, the ones on the left break later than the one on the right. You can build a strategy to protect the ones you care for the most!

Oh, also, all equipments will be fixed at the garage now. The drugstore will be there only to change and upgrade caring tools.

[h3]Holowatch[/h3]
We noticed something odd about the watch. At this point, its whole inner workings where you use it to select missions, check the minimap and change the radio, is just a side effect of an old design of the game that you never saw which enabled much more. Most of it was scrapped so... let's scrap it completely! To start a mission, you'll just have to go to the patient now. The radio? There will be a dedicated button to tune to the next. And the map? It will just look like your current experience: always there! The only controls you'll now have on the watch will be to change the current objective, so you can still easily go to the nearest garage or drugstore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/a575fee39c3d0c5234904c7d00bf9c692b34b89b.gif[/img]

[h3]Third Person View?!![/h3]
On this, we would really love to hear you so read me out. It's really the biggest of all the changes. The games feels really different if we go this route and you can really help us by weighing in.

While we really love our top-down old school driving gameplay, it has some issues. 

The glaring one is that not everyone is confortable with the inputs associated with it. That's why early on, we decided to add an alternative control scheme that lets you just push into the direction that you want. It's very tricky to get right and we're not happy with it yet, especially with a keyboard. I noticed Deliver at All Costs also as it but completely removes the feature if you're playing with a keyboard, I understand why...

Another issue is that top down games are actually really hard to market! "Who cares?" you might say. Well, we put more than 200 000€ in this game already and we're not even halfway through. So you might understand why we would really love for it to be successful, you know... Our lives literally depend on it.

There are other minor reasons, but I wanted to try something... I did a very quick hack of a third person view of our game. It's probably quite different that what it would be if done properly, but it already gives an idea. It's still pretty much top-down so you can see our beautiful rooftops, but it's much closer to what a regular driving game looks like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/1195d0f024d88710183d88d42e6daa5fc2a6ddd5.gif[/img]

I was not expecting much of it. We were surprised. We put the videos here and there, on discords, slacks, subreddits... Comments seem to lean towards the 3rd person view but both sides have very good arguments!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/45491e40ca5c86e133bafd53f354184a0c33fda7.gif[/img]

Advantages are: it's easier to pick up as left and right are never reversed. It's [i]probably[/i] easier to market (we are going to make some tests, don't act surprised if you come across those on socials :D) 
Disadvantages: it's much harder to see cars coming from adjacent roads! It's also less cute... 

[b]What do you think?[/b] This is not a drill, we really want your opinion on this.

[h2]For Next Time[/h2]
There's a lot more that I wanted to say but I'm going to keep this for next time! Want a tease? We are also making big changes to the pacing of the game! Did you think we were sleeping for a month? Not at all! Well, except Daniel, a bit...

[b]Please come tell us what you think of these upcoming changes in the comments, on discord, on socials, wherever![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #16 - Demo update!
notes.notes:
Hello to our wanabee paramedics!

A weekly devlog on a monday?! Yes, we worked a lot to deliver the update of the demo and it delayed the news a bit... As promised last week, we [b]updated the demo[/b] of Highway to Heal! This update takes into account some of your feedback (others need more time) and let's you discover new areas of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/6080bfbb7f23d8d0e5773146b4d530052716db64.gif[/img]

It might(?) not seem much, but a lot of work went into this update. There is a lot of things that happens behind the curtains and doesn't necessarily show explicitly, but it's necessary work for the development of a video game. We tried a lot of things to improve the minimap and it's still not perfect yet. We do believe it's better though and we have a few things up our sleeves that might finally make it just right. If you need a copilot to read it, [b]bring in a friend[/b], it's fun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899360/Highway_to_Heal_Demo/
[h2]Changelog[/h2]
🚑 [b]Mission replay[/b] (from the ambulance center) 
📜 Added [b]two new missions[/b] in the evening (removed Basile's mission) 
🗺️ Minimap interface update  
🚘 AI vehicles now avoid colliding with trashcans and lamp posts when the siren is active...  
💡 Cars and lamp posts more visible in bad weather conditions 
🥵 Rebalanced difficulty 
📝 Feedback survey accessible from pause menu 
🐞 Various bugfixes and minor improvements 
🪧 Fixed missing credits 
👀 And a few surprises!

[h2]Crowdfunding[/h2]
We are seeing the finish line! [url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal]The campaign ends this sunday[/url] so there's barely [b]seven days left[/b] and we need all your help to ensure we complete those [b]last 14%[/b]! We know a few of you are waiting for the last minute to pledge, but we really need your help sooner than later! We would very much love adding a few stretch goals.

[url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/57ce38b99131383ba24ce4ab8b051dcaa0a36c8a.png"][/img][/url]

If you already contributed, please share the campaign with your friends, family... [b]Ask your favorite streamers to play the demo[/b], that could help a lot too!

[url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/ba26cdb0732fbeeef481ff67aa28274935ed3405.png"][/img][/url]

While this campaign is ending, work on funding and developing the game continues. We will be at [url=https://www.sogames.org/]Game Invest [/url]in Bordeaux and [url=https://gamecamp.fr/]Game Camp [/url]in Lille to find partners to help us bring the complete game to you. 

In the next update, you should finally be able to [b]go to the City Hall [/b]and get the list of ongoing works added to your minimap, amongst other things.

[b]Take care![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #13 - Demo Update & Crowdfunding Campaign!
notes.notes:
Heallo! (bit of a stretch on that one, right?)

It's time for the weekly devlog again!

[h2]Demo Update[/h2]
Today, we are releasing a [b]small update to our demo[/b]. While the last two weeks were very small to us, as France as many days off in May, and even if we were super busy with the crowdfunding campaign, we managed to squeeze in quite a few improvements!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899360/Highway_to_Heal_Demo/
Most notable is a [b]big audio improvement pass [/b]on the Super Stretcher, the caring games (almost playable just by ear!), etc. We also added audio to the main menu and it made a bit more playful in the process. I won't say more, I'll just let you discover that in our free demo.

Also, it looks like I lied last week. While the [b]vehicle AI [/b]is still needs a lot of work, we managed to make a small bugfix that should help a lot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/325fcb5d99fae6185660ea522f40644a478722b2.gif[/img]

[h3]Overall list of updates[/h3]
📢 Sound Design upgrade
🌧️ Lit windows while raining,
🗺️ Interface upgrades to the minimap and the mission icon,
🚗 Small vehicle AI bugfix,
🏙️ Some small changes in the level design,
🐞 Various minor bugfixes and typos.

[h2]Crowdfunding[/h2]
Our [b][url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal?utm_campaign=ulule&utm_source=steam]crowdfunding campaign[/url][/b] went live last tuesday and it started off very well! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/2aecde00ca95b4b2a4e2fd3aca5acc6a32c6f6ae.gif[/img]

Thanks to everyone who supported us already, it is already [b]70% funded in just three days[/b]! 

If you did not pitch in already, know that not only supporting us helps us finish the creation of the game, it also enables [b]you[/b] to participate in its development! The reward tiers allow you to:

🪧 [b]Name a street [/b]of Le Mascaret, (included at every level!)
🎮 [b]Access the beta [/b]version of the game and provide feedback,
🗣️ And even contribute to the [b]design of a character or a mission[/b]!

We started asking the current backers what ideas they had for street names in the game. Here's a few: 
[list]
[*]Rue Hamtaro (that will probably end up being spelled Amtaraud or something, for legal reasons),
[*]Rue de la Procrastination (street of procrastinating, in which you probably never start a mission), 
[*]Boulevard Andrew Hozier Byrne, (we will probably ask him if he's okay with that!)
[*]Rue Alain Proviste, (a classic and very nice french pun, it had to be there!)
[/list]Join our club and pitch in the crowdfunding campaign so you can also include your favorite pet's name in the game! 🐈

[url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal?utm_campaign=ulule&utm_source=steam][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/57ce38b99131383ba24ce4ab8b051dcaa0a36c8a.png[/img][/url]

If you can't participate, that's fine, please just [b]help us share the news [/b]around with your friends, your family and anyone you think could be interested!

[h2]Games Made in France[/h2]
Games Made in France has started yesterday and we're already seeing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GamesMadeInFrance]many great games[/url]! [b]Come see us with MisterMV and Trinity this Sunday at 8pm[/b]! We will tell all the nice things about the game and answer your questions in the Twitch Chat! (in french)

[url=https://twitch.tv/mistermv][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/17b0458d07fccb518f0e3981e5ce95193df1ec8c.jpg[/img][/url]

To conclude: drive fast... but carefully! 😎

PS: join on our Discord server. There, we unveiled a special link allowing you to support the project with a [b]20% discount[/b]!

notes.title: Weekly Devlog #11 - Demo release!
notes.notes:
HEY!
Finally!
After intense months of work, the demo as landed! Stop reading this and just [b]go play[/b] it! Also, fill in the feedback form as there's a chance to win a free copy of the game 👀

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2899360/Highway_to_Heal_Demo/

Still reading? M'okay, you're a curious one. Or maybe you played the demo already? In both cases, nice! Because I can tell you a few things you might find interesting or funny.

[h2]Last minute tweaks and fixes[/h2]
Of course it didn't take us a full week to just a press a green "release" button. We were busy fixing bugs and improving things. 

A good one that made the cut was a [b]blue silhouette[/b] that shows up whenever there is something in front of the ambulance, like the corner of a building or a tree, so that you never lose its sight. This one was in the works for a while but we needed to find a workaround of a bug in Unity to pull it out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/a1e8bb3d6bb661e20643b4505c58137fe9f16538.gif[/img]

We also added a [b]proper english[/b] translation which we hope you'll find as funny as reading the french version of the game. Thomas also improved a bit the minimap so that icons are easier to spot. 

[h2]Demo Release Day[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/8ed1401a1e6c94d1b5b9a0a94c40361b3501f178.jpg[/img]
Who is this? Just a Daniel going [b]berserk on bugs[/b]. This was just a couple hours before the release! You might have noticed people in the background. There usually isn't that many people at the office. But this was the evening of the local gamedev gathering. 

Since people were coming in, Daniel just gave them the controller instead of testing himself the demo. Obviously people quite easily [b]found a few bugs[/b] and Daniel just doesn't like those. So, the demo could have released a few hours earlier with a few not so important bugs, but no, Daniel had to fix them! And so he did. 

At about 10pm, he proudly took a beer, went into the middle of the room and [b]used its beer as a bell[/b] to get people's attention. You know how loud a beer sounds? Actually, not loud at all. It does do a good splash show though, so people's attention was gathered indeed. After a nice laugh and half a beer expressly drank, Daniel could finally tell everyone : [i]DEMO IS RELEASED[/i]! That was fun.

[h2]Upcoming Event[/h2]
As much as the team would love to continue working on the game, adding new missions, implementing new features like the City Hall or just improving things overall, the attention is somewhere else. Indeed, [b]finances are tight[/b] and solutions need to be found to finish development in fine conditions.

That's why our attention is instead going to one of our options: our [url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal]crowdfunding campaign on Ulule[/url]! There's still a lot of work to set it up but it should start very soon. Subscribe so that you don't miss the start!
[url=https://ulule.com/highwaytoheal][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751614/ccc42613c969afade8a4dc337d51341872f8f264.png[/img][/url]

Also, you'll be able to see Thomas and Daniel on a big french game event on Twitch very soon. 👀 
We can't wait to tell you more about it.
